App ko khula rakhne ki zaroorat nahi, bas phone on rahe.\n\nWhatsApp calls yeh build nahi pakadti. Agar WhatsApp calls bhi chahiyen to website ke download safhe se \"WhatsApp wali\" app lein.
Shop ka PC (LAN Mode)

Shop ka internet band ho jaye to yeh phone calls seedha shop ke computer ko usi WiFi par bhej sakta hai — counter par popup aata rehta hai. Us PC par NestPOS agent ki window kholein aur LAN Mode on karein; wahan ek address aur 6 hindson ka code likha aata hai. Dono cheezein yahan ek dafa daal dein.
Kisi PC se juda nahi. Calls sirf cloud par ja rahi hain.

Yeh shop ke network ka address nahi hai. Bilkul wohi likhein jo agent window dikhati hai, misal ke tor par 192.168.1.17.
Is address par NestPOS nahi mila. Dekh lein ke PC on hai, agent ki window khuli hai aur LAN Mode on hai, aur yeh phone usi WiFi par hai.
Code ghalat hai. Agent window par har baar naya 6 hindson ka code aata hai — abhi jo screen par hai wohi daalein.
Bohat dafa ghalat code daala gaya. Chand minute rukein, phir koshish karein.
Cloud hi asal hai. Jab tak internet chal raha hai app usi par kaam karti hai — PC sirf backup raasta hai. Malik jab chahe PC ki agent window se is phone ko alag kar sakta hai.
